full_check_driver:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
task_root="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/../.." && pwd)"
for variant in borrowed-errors h1-empty-tracking h2-borrowed-timer; do
  source_dir="$task_root/artifacts/performance-2026-10-20/dedicated-linux-final/$variant"
  mkdir -p "$source_dir/target"
  docker run --rm --security-opt seccomp=unconfined \
    -v "$source_dir:/work:ro" -v maximus-cargo:/usr/local/cargo \
    -v maximus-target:/work/target -e CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/work/target -w /work rust:1.96-bookworm bash -c '
      set -euo pipefail
      rustup component add clippy rustfmt
      cargo clean --profile dev -p maximus-core -p maximus-http1 -p maximus-http2 -p maximus -p maximus-router
      scripts/check.sh
    ' > "$task_root/artifacts/performance-2026-10-20/dedicated-$variant-full-check.log" 2>&1
  (cd "$source_dir" && scripts/test-interop-linux.sh) \
    > "$task_root/artifacts/performance-2026-10-20/dedicated-$variant-interop.log" 2>&1
  echo "$variant full checks and interoperability PASS"
done
